meaning:
κακουχέω, -ῶ
(κακόν, ἔχω), [in LXX: 3Ki.2:26 11:39 (עָנָה pi., hith.)* ;]
to ill-treat, hurt, torment: pass. ptcp., Heb.11:37 13:3.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: They were stoned. They were sawn apart. They were tempted. They were slain with the sword. They went around in sheep skins and in goat skins; being destitute…
